_doc: Voice settings shared by every video (tools/make_vo.py). A line's role in videos/<name>/audio/lines.tsv picks a voice from 'roles'; a video can override any of this in its own audio/voices.json. Voices are VieNeu-TTS v3 Turbo presets: run `.venv/bin/python tools/make_vo.py --list` to see them all.
_tempo: speaking rate per role, without changing the pitch: 1 = as the model speaks, .92 = 8% slower. A line can set its own in lines.tsv.
